def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    vals=[v for row in I for v in row]
    fg=[v for v in set(vals) if v!=0 and v!=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)]
    # shape = non-background nonzero color
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(vals); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]

    fgc=others[0]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==fgc]
    mr=min(i for i,j in cells); mc=min(j for i,j in cells)
    S={(i-mr,j-mc) for i,j in cells}
    h=max(i for i,j in S); w=max(j for i,j in S)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    offs=[]
    for di in range(-h,H):
        for dj in range(-w,W):
            ok=True
            for i,j in S:
                x,y=i+di,j+dj
                if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and I[x][y]!=0:

                offs.append((di-mr,dj-mc))
                for i,j in S:
                    x,y=i+di,j+dj
